question: On 25 April 2025, DRDO achieved a significant milestone by conducting a long-duration ground test of an active cooled scramjet subscale combustor. How long did this test last?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1,000 seconds**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)** conducted a significant long-duration ground test of an **active cooled scramjet subscale combustor** on **25 April 2025**.
 
• The test lasted for an impressive duration of **1,000 seconds**, marking a major milestone in India’s efforts toward advanced propulsion technologies.
 
• A scramjet combustor is an advanced engine technology where the air-breathing propulsion system operates at **supersonic speeds**, significantly reducing fuel consumption and increasing efficiency.
 
• The successful test demonstrates India’s growing capabilities in developing **next-generation air-breathing propulsion systems**, which are essential for hypersonic flight and space exploration.
 
• Such advancements are critical for **defense applications** and for strengthening India’s position in global aerospace innovation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **What is a Scramjet Engine?**

 
 
• A **scramjet engine** (Supersonic Combustion Ramjet) is an advanced air-breathing propulsion system designed to operate at **supersonic speeds**.
 
• The main feature of scramjet technology is that it compresses incoming air for combustion without the need for a rotating compressor, unlike conventional jet engines.
 
• Scramjets are considered essential for achieving **hypersonic speeds (Mach 5 and above)**, making them ideal for applications in defense and space exploration.
 
 
 
• **Significance of the DRDO Test:**
 
 
• The successful test of the scramjet combustor for **1,000 seconds** ensures India’s capability in developing **indigenous hypersonic technologies**.
 
• It showcases advancements in material science, thermal management, and propulsion engineering.
 
• The active cooled feature ensures that the engine can withstand the extreme temperatures generated during supersonic combustion.
 
 
 
• **Applications of Scramjet Technology:**
 
 
• Scramjet engines are crucial for **hypersonic missiles**, which can travel at speeds greater than Mach 5, rendering them difficult to intercept.
 
• They are used in **space launch vehicles** for cost-efficient satellite deployment.
 
• Scramjets are also being explored for future **commercial hypersonic flights**.
 
 
 
• **Global Context:**
 
 
• Countries like the **United States, Russia, and China** are also working on scramjet-based propulsion systems, emphasizing its strategic importance.
 
• India’s achievement through DRDO places it among the few nations capable of developing such **cutting-edge aerospace technologies**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Active Cooling System:**

 
 
• It is a crucial component of the scramjet combustor, designed to manage the extreme heat generated during supersonic combustion.
 
• The system ensures the structural integrity of the combustor and enhances its operational efficiency.
 
 
 
• **Hypersonic Technology Development Vehicle (HSTDV):**
 
 
• The HSTDV is an ambitious project by DRDO to develop **hypersonic cruise missiles** and reusable space launch vehicles.
 
• The scramjet combustor test is a critical step in achieving the goals of the HSTDV program.
